description.short: Start and continue T3 Code work from Microsoft Teams.
description.full: Starts or continues T3 engineering work only when an authorized user explicitly mentions the bot in a configured channel. Other messages from authorized users in configured channels provide quoted, untrusted context only. Context is kept in memory for at most one hour and 50 messages by default; it is not backfilled or retained across restarts. Unmapped channels and unauthorized users are discarded. Personal and group chats are disabled.

commands.title: stop
commands.description: Stop the active T3 turn in this conversation.

commands.title: approve
commands.description: Approve a pending T3 request by request id.

commands.title: deny
commands.description: Deny a pending T3 request by request id.

commands.title: answer
commands.description: Answer a T3 user-input request with a JSON object.
